visuals.heading: Test a Lane Before You Commit

items.text: Spending above roughly 20% needs course-specific proof: placement median, licence requirement, faculty and alumni access.
Keep the rest for living costs, tools, internet, projects and upskilling after the degree.
UGC NET: for Assistant Professor eligibility needs a master's with 55% marks (50% for reserved categories).
B.Ed: the proposed one-year B.Ed (draft NCTE rules) is for four-year degree holders and postgraduates.
Exams like UPSC, SSC and banking: any bachelor's degree qualifies, whether three or four years.

blocks.heading: Skill Layer That Raises Your Pay

items.text: AI-assisted research, with verification: use AI to summarise and draft, then check every fact.
Spoken and written English: a multiplier across every lane, from interviews to client emails.
Selling and clear offers: knowing how to explain what you do and ask for work is what later makes freelancing and consulting possible.
Talk to one person actually doing the job or holding the seat, and ask what a normal week looks like and what they wish they had known.
When you message them, keep it to one specific observation about their work, a link to your proof, and one small question.
